content: The document discusses the use of specific intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) therapy for COVID-19 and presents a series of analyses comparing outcomes between patients treated with specific IVIG and those who received no treatment. The findings are illustrated through various forest plots, which are statistical tools used to visually represent the results of meta-analyses. Below are the detailed descriptions of the figures and their respective outcomes: 1. Figure 1: This graph illustrates the risk of bias across all included studies, presented as percentages. It reflects the judgments made by the review authors regarding the potential for bias in each study. 2. Figure 2: This summary provides a detailed breakdown of the risk of bias for each individual study included in the analysis. It highlights the specific areas where bias may have been present. 3. Figure 3: A forest plot comparing the 28-day mortality rate between patients treated with specific IVIG and those who received no treatment. This analysis evaluates whether IVIG has an impact on survival within 28 days of treatment. 4. Figure 4: A forest plot comparing the proportion of patients hospitalized and requiring invasive mechanical ventilation at 7 days between the IVIG-treated group and the no-treatment group. 5. Figure 5: A forest plot analyzing the occurrence of serious adverse events in patients treated with specific IVIG versus those who received no treatment. 6. Figure 6: A forest plot comparing the duration from enrollment to hospital discharge (in days) between the IVIG-treated group and the no-treatment group. 7. Figure 7: A forest plot evaluating the proportion of patients discharged from the hospital at 28 days in the IVIG-treated group compared to the no-treatment group. 8. Figure 8: A forest plot comparing the proportion of patients hospitalized but not requiring supplemental oxygen at 7 days between the IVIG-treated group and the no-treatment group. 9. Figure 9: A forest plot analyzing the proportion of patients hospitalized and requiring any form of supplemental oxygen at 7 days in the IVIG-treated group versus the no-treatment group. 10. Figure 10: A forest plot comparing the proportion of patients hospitalized and requiring noninvasive ventilation or high-flow oxygen devices at 7 days between the IVIG-treated group and the no-treatment group. 11. Figure 11: A forest plot analyzing the duration from enrollment to hospital discharge (in days) for patients receiving a specific IVIG dose of 0.15 g/kg compared to those who received no treatment. 12. Figure 12: A forest plot comparing the duration from enrollment to hospital discharge (in days) for patients receiving a specific IVIG dose of 0.2 g/kg versus no treatment. 13. Figure 13: A forest plot analyzing the duration from enrollment to hospital discharge (in days) for patients receiving a specific IVIG dose of 0.25 g/kg compared to those who received no treatment. 14. Figure 14: A forest plot comparing the duration from enrollment to hospital discharge (in days) for patients receiving a specific IVIG dose of 0.3 g/kg versus no treatment. 15. Figure 15: A forest plot evaluating whether patients treated with specific IVIG showed improvement to a better clinical category at 7 days compared to their baseline condition, in contrast to those who received no treatment. These analyses collectively aim to assess the efficacy and safety of specific IVIG therapy in the treatment of COVID-19, focusing on various clinical outcomes such as mortality, hospitalization status, adverse events, and recovery time.
